title: Phone Storage Cleaner: Cleanup
summary: Select & delete unwanted files to clear space with the Phone Storage Cleaner app
description:
Having trouble clearing up space on your device? Phone Storage Cleaner helps you review and delete unwanted files. This app allows you to scan your photos, videos, documents, and downloads, enabling you to select and delete them.

Select and Delete Unwanted Files:
With Phone Storage Cleaner, you get an overview of your storage. The app categorizes your files into different sections, allowing you to browse and delete unnecessary files with ease.

You can:

• Check Photos, Videos and Audios – Users can select and remove unwanted pictures, videos and audios to get more space.
• Sort Documents & Downloads – Users can review and delete documents, PDFs, and downloaded files easily.

Find Large Files:

Phone Storage Cleaner helps users identify large files that take up more space. The app finds and displays a list of the large files, allowing users to review them and decide what to keep or delete.

Find and Remove Duplicate Photos:

Phone Storage Cleaner finds duplicate photos, making it easy to remove them.

This app focuses on helping you control what you want to keep and what you want to delete.

Required permissions:

To perform the described functionality, the application uses the following permissions.
GET_PACKAGE_SIZE - Allows the app to find out the space used by installed packages.

To access all device files, the application requests the following permissions.
MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE - Allows full access to external storage in scoped storage.
WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE - Allows the app to write to external storage.
